feeds.title: Sharing Kindergarten Blog
feeds.description: I'm Mary, a Kindergarten teacher from Georgia. I am a learner. I have a Bachelors and Masters degree in early childhood education as well as a specialist degree in Instructional Technology. I adore my small family. I love blogging, creating games, and instructing little minds. Teaching is my life's passion.

feeds.title: Simply Kinder - Kindergarten Teaching Blog
feeds.description: Kindergarten can be developmentally appropriate, academic, & fun. We take the stress out of planning these rich experiences for teachers & families by sharing activities kids will love.

feeds.title: The Kindergarten Connection Blog
feeds.description: The Kindergarten Connection is full of fun ideas and inspiration for preschool-1st grade. You will find fun learning activities designed with preschool, kindergarten, and first grade in mind. From crafts and printables, to lessons, games, and more.

feeds.title: The Kindergarten Smorgasboard Blog
feeds.description: A male kindergarten teacher who loves to share ideas and tips and resources. My real name is Greg Smedley-Warren. I have been teaching for 11 years. I spent a year teaching fifth grade, two years in second grade and am now in my 9th year in Kindergarten. Kindergarten is my passion and my calling but honestly, that wasn't how it started.

feeds.title: Time 4 Kindergarten
feeds.description: A kindergarten blog for kindergarten teachers. Sharing math, literacy, language arts, common core, and more. Also find ideas to teach reading, math, sight word recognition, and classroom organization.

feeds.title: Kindergarten Worksheets And Games
feeds.description: Kindergarten Worksheets And Games is a resource for parents, teachers, and homeschoolers to make learning fun! We have kindergarten worksheets, alphabet printables and activities, Kindergarten math, Kindergarten Science, Kindergarten Social Studies, Kindergarten Literacy activities, and Kindergarten crafts.

feeds.title: First Grade Blue Skies Blog
feeds.description: My name is Jennifer White and I am the author behind First Grade Blue Skies. I've taught First Grade and Third Grade, but currently I teach Kindergarten at Appalachian Elementary.

feeds.title: Kindergarten Chaos Blog
feeds.description: Kindergarten Chaos is a blog with multiple social media channels, where you can find tons of ideas and suggestions for teaching PreK, Kindergarten, & 1st.

feeds.title: Creative Kindergarten Blog
feeds.description: Hi! I am Amanda, I am an Early Childhood Educator in Ontario, Canada and I love coming up with hands-on, engaging centers for my students. I hope that my blog inspires you and sparks new ideas for your classroom. From math and literacy or science and technology- I hope that I can make your teaching life easier!

feeds.title: Kindergarten Korner Blog
feeds.description: Hello, I'm Casey from Kindergarten Korner! I have been teaching kindergarten and loving it since 2006. Kindergartenkorner.com is a website dedicated to providing teachers and homeschooling parents with helpful resources, classroom decor and organization ideas, product recommendations, and much more!

feeds.title: Mrs. Richardson's Class Blog
feeds.description: Hi there! I'm Amanda. I taught several years in both kindergarten and first-grade classrooms before taking on Mrs. Richardson's Class full time while staying home to care for our children. I am a Christ-follower, wife, mommy, friend, and always a teacher. I am married to a wonderful man who loves and serves our family so well. I love crafting engaging lessons for little learners and making teachers' jobs easier by providing easy to implement resources and lesson tips.

feeds.title: Sweet For Kindergarten Blog
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Kristina and I love teaching Kindergarten! I started blogging in July 2015 to share my teaching ideas. Check out my articles at Sweet for Kindergarten to find teaching inspiration & tips, lesson ideas, easy-to-use resources, and hands-on activities for your Kindergarten classroom.

feeds.title: Mrs. Bremer's Class
feeds.description: My name is Anita, and I have taught in the primary grades (K-2) for over 20 years. I love sharing my classroom ideas and teaching tips. I spend my days creating quality learning resources for K-2 classrooms to help students love learning, and to make life easier for busy teachers like YOU.

feeds.title: Kreative in Life Blog
feeds.description: My name is Crystal and I live in Texas. I write the blog Kreative in Life. As a teacher, my focus was the whole child. Loving, caring, teaching and preparing children for life. I have worked in education for over ten years as a teacher, teacher's aide, assistant Montessori teacher and substitute teacher. I have spent the last seven years teaching kindergarten.

feeds.title: The Classroom Collaborative Blog
feeds.description: Mrs. Wills' Kindergarten aims to provide Kindergarten teachers with valuable resources, lesson plans, and activities to help enhance the effectiveness of their teaching and better their overall classroom environments. Mrs. Wills has years of experience both teaching and coaching teachers. Follow to get Kindergarten lesson plans & activities are made simple with resources from Mrs. Wills' Kindergarten.

feeds.title: KFUNdamentals
feeds.description: This blog has educational materials for kindergarten, transitional kindergarten, and preschool. I am Palma Lindsay and I'm passionate about my family and teaching kindergarten. I also love crafts, blogging, cooking, presenting at conferences and keeping the FUN in the FUNdamentals.

feeds.title: I Love Kindergarten
feeds.description: This is a blog about loving kindergarten. I love to share teaching ideas and all the fun learning we do everyday. I also enjoy creating resources for the classroom, and presenting at conferences about kindergarten math, literacy, and classroom strategies.

feeds.title: Mairtown Kindergarten
feeds.description: Mairtown Kindergarten provides a safe, nurturing, fun environment that enables children to grow up as competent and confident learners.

feeds.title: Bream Bay Kindergarten
feeds.description: Bream Bay Kindergarten is located along the beautiful coast of Bream Bay, located within the township of Ruakaka. Our programme draws from the interests of the child and is supported by the strengths and passions of the educators, whanau and community surrounding the child.

feeds.title: Kindergarten Cafe
feeds.description: Welcome to Kindergarten Cafe - your home for teaching ideas, activities, and strategies across all content areas! I am Zeba McGibbon and I love creating resources for teachers and sharing my teaching experience with others. Kindergarten Cafe is aimed for kindergarten, but teachers of Preschool-First grade can find resources here for their students!

feeds.title: The Brown Bag Teacher Blog
feeds.description: A Kentucky 1st grade teacher Catherine Reed, who loves all things books, tech, and blogging. In her fourth year of teaching, she leads a combination K/1 class with 13 first graders and 11 kindergarten friends. Join her for weekly classroom updates and free resources.

feeds.title: kindermomma.com
feeds.description: KinderMomma is a relatable, humorous and relevant blog site where parents and teachers can find helpful information and discounted products.

feeds.title: Little Minds at Work Blog
feeds.description: My name is Tara West and this is my little piece of the internet. I am a kindergarten teacher.

feeds.title: Mr Bohl's Bog
feeds.description: Hello, I'm Kathy Bohl. I love teaching Kindergarten children and I am thrilled to be part of your kinder's first year at Georgetown. I love sharing information and reading books to the Kinders. Join me and let's learn & grow together in Kindergarten.

feeds.title: Kinder Craze
feeds.description: A Kindergarten Teaching Blog by Maria Gavin. The Kinder-Craze blog is loaded with ideas & inspiration for classroom teachers and features content & crafts for toddlers & preschoolers. You'll also find printable classroom activities and instructional decor.

feeds.title: Roots and Wings
feeds.description: This blog features one teacher's approach to kindergarten, inspired by the early childhood practices of Reggio, Montessori, and Waldorf, but applied to a public school setting. I am passionate about project work, inquiry-based learning, STEAM education, nature study and preparing my littles for the future. Visit the free resource library found on the homepage for lots of kindergarten goodness!

feeds.title: KinderGals
feeds.description: Kim is a retired kindergarten teacher. She taught kindergarten for 30 years and now works as a national presenter. Now that she is retired, she spends her time volunteering in Megan's room.

feeds.title: Mrs Jump's class
feeds.description: Mrs. Jump's Class is a website and blog created to share and collaborate with teachers around the world. Mrs. Jump has taught K & 1 for 15 years and has a clear passion for education. You will find ideas, pictures, printables, and a fun look at the day in the life of a kindergarten teacher.

feeds.title: RunPTO
feeds.description: The Complete Management System for PTO and PTA.

feeds.title: The Kinderhearted Classroom
feeds.description: I'm Elizabeth Coller, a Kindergarten teacher who has worked in education for the last ten years. Kindergarten is where my heart is at and I love sharing tips, ideas, and best practices!

feeds.title: Live, Laugh, I LOVE Kindergarten
feeds.description: A teacher blog focusing on the primary grades. Weekly freebies and daily ideas for every teacher looking to make their classroom more successful. This blog is authored by Kimberly Ann, a kindergarten teacher living in Minnesota.

feeds.title: Inquiring Minds: Mrs. Myers' Kindergarten
feeds.description: I am a Kindergarten Teacher for West Carrollton City Schools. I have taught kindergarten for 23 years. In this blog, you will see both teacher and students on a journey to build up our minds, muscles, and imaginations through inquiry, investigation, exploration, problem solving and teamwork. I am having inquiring, exploring and learning along side my students.

feeds.title: Heidi Songs
feeds.description: She has somehow managed to stay in Kindergarten all of those years, with the exception of five years in first grade and a few months in preschooL. Combining a strong knowledge of brain research with practical experience, Heidi has created a wealth of fun and engaging teaching techniques that work well with diverse populations.

feeds.title: Colors and Kindergarten
feeds.description: I am a wife, a mommy, and a Kindergarten teacher. I love camping, hiking, kayaking, reading, drawing and coloring (yes, I do!), and spending time with my amazing family.

feeds.title: Kindergarten Crayons
feeds.description: My name is Fran Kramer, a kindergarten teacher and a blogger. I have been teaching kindergarten for over 25 years in Southern California. I am a trainer for my district and love working with kindergarten teachers and young children.

feeds.title: Mrs. Albanese's Kindergarten Class
feeds.description: I am going into my 10th year teaching, all of which is in Kindergarten. I teach at a Catholic School in Woodbridge, Ontario (about 20 minutes north of Toronto). I have a combined class of both Junior and Senior Kindergarten students (pre-k and k). I come to school each day with a huge smile on my face and so do my students.

feeds.title: Kindergarten Faith
feeds.description: To have Faith means to believe in something you can not see. I can not see what the future will hold for my Kindergarten Stars, but I can have Faith and trust that God will give me the skills and love to start shaping each and every little life I touch in my Kindergarten classroom. I have been teaching for 14 years and for the last 8 years I have been enjoying the wonderful world of kindergarten.

feeds.title: Krazee 4 Kindergarten
feeds.description: I am in my eighth year of teaching Kindergarten and couldn't see myself teaching any other grade! I am lucky enough to be teaching at the same school my mom teaches 2nd grade at. I love creating fun & engaging activities for my students to use.

feeds.title: The Adventures of a K/1 Teacher
feeds.description: My name is Kim and I am a Kinder/1st Grade Academic Interventionist! I work with small groups of students who need more support in Reading and Math. I also work with all students at my school with dyslexia (grades K-3).

feeds.title: Miss Bindergarten's Classroom
feeds.description: Miss Bindergarten's Classroom blog is a resource for kindergarten teachers, parents and students to ask questions and share ideas.

feeds.title: Down River Resources
feeds.description: Helping Teachers Stay Afloat with Diverse and Rigorous Resources This is an educational blog about kindergarten, first, and second grade.

feeds.title: The Curious Kindergarten
feeds.description: Welcome to The Curious Kindergarten, a blog about the discoveries my students and I make in our full-day kindergarten A bit about me: I have been teaching Kindergarten for several years and have recently started implementing some philosophies from Reggio Emilia into my classroom. Our learning journey is a work in progress.

feeds.title: Literacy and Laughter - Celebrating Kindergarten children and the books they love
feeds.description: I teach All Day Kindergarten at Madeira Elementary. My passion is teaching literacy skills to young children. We love books, Writer's Workshop, Math and Science notebooks, and being a cool community of learners.You will see us learning and growing together, with love and laughter.

feeds.title: Our Kindergarten Journey
feeds.description: Miss Marie Pliura and Mrs. Tortola are Kindergarten Teachers and Jr. Dance Teachers at Gatestone Elementary.

feeds.title: Mrs. Brown's Kindergarten Blog
feeds.description: I am a Kindergarten teacher who loves anything and everything about teaching at the K level. I love sharing ideas and learning everyday with and from my students. I am also a high school cheerleading coach and enjoy being able to work with 5/6 year olds by day and teenagers by night.

feeds.title: TransformingEd
feeds.description: Joanne Marie Babalis blogs from her TransformEd Creative Studio Space in Toronto, Ontario, Canada.Joanne Marie Babalis is also a kindergarten teacher who has been blogging for five years about her Reggio Emilia-inspired classroom transformation.

feeds.title: The Wonderful World of Kindergarten
feeds.description: Welcome to our Reggio Emilia inspired classroom at Dr. David Suzuki School.

feeds.title: Mrs. Helgason's Colours of Kindergarten
feeds.description: Welcome to French Kindergarten teacher Mrs. Helgason & Mrs. Meredith's Kindergarten class. We are a Catholic French Immersion full day program located at St. Anne Elementary School in Kanata, Ontario. This blog will give you a glimpse into your child's daily learning and the extra curricular activities that are ongoing throughout the year.

feeds.title: Yeehaw! Teaching in Texas
feeds.description: My name is Sarah and I am a teacher in the great state of Texas. This is my fifth year of teaching and I absolutely love it. I have taught Kindergarten and First Grade. I have always wanted to be a teacher and I am so blessed to do what I love every day.

feeds.title: HMS KINDERGARTEN
feeds.description: HMS KINDERGARTEN is a blog of Haultain Memorial School and Calgary Board of Education (CBE). We believe every one of our students is unique and personalized learning is the key to their success. From kindergarten to Grade 12.

feeds.title: Kindergarten English Landing
feeds.description: Welcome to kindergarten at English Landing. Our kindergarten students learn, grow, and experience success each day in our classrooms! Enjoy 'stepping' inside our rooms and discovering how much fun Kindergarten can be.

feeds.title: Kiddos Connect Blog
feeds.description: Our experience is in: Kindergarten, First Grad, Preschool.

feeds.title: Good-bye Kindergarten
feeds.description: Hi ! Since 1995, I have been 'Mrs. Hugo' to over 700 kindergarteners in suburban Chicago. I have taught the Common and the uncommon. This will be my last year of teaching and I'm excited to share it with all of you!

feeds.title: Teaching With Love and Laughter
feeds.description: Teaching With Love and Laughter is a blog created by Lori Rosenberg. A kindergarten, first grade, and second grade teaching blog. I focus on writing, grammar, reading, and social studies.

feeds.title: Passionately Curious Educators: Connecting Lifelong Learners
feeds.description: Tracy Pickard and Cheryl Emrich are a Full Day Kindergarten Early Learning Team. They work at Howard Robertson Public School in Kitchener, Ontario for the Waterloo Region District School Board. Their blog invites educators to peak inside our Full Day Kindergarten classroom and into our thought process. Sharing our reflections on practice.

feeds.title: Kindergarten Tales
feeds.description: Adventures in Mrs. MacRae, Mme. Lepage and Mrs. Pignat's Kindergarten Class. The focus of the Full-Day Early Learning Kindergarten Program is to establish a strong foundation for learning. We provide a classroom environment that is conducive to learning and that helps meet the developmental needs of each child.

feeds.title: Herding Kats in Kindergarten
feeds.description: I'm an early childhood teacher with experience in 1st grade, Kindergarten and full-day Pre-K. I've taught for 6 years. Teaching is my 3rd career - I'm an Army veteran and I was a stay-at-home mama for 7 years. I teach at a Title I school in Oklahoma. I love to incorporate movement and music throughout my day and I am a big proponent of free choice centers.

feeds.title: Kindergarten Lifestyle
feeds.description: This blog is about my life. I am the owner of Kindergarten Lifestyle. I use to teach kinder, 1st, and 2nd. I create teacher resource materials that are fun and engaging for primary students. I am a former public school teacher turned homeschool mom of six. I spend my time homeschooling and homesteading. We Live Life Simple with our Kindergarten Lifestyle.

feeds.title: Dr. Clements' Kindergarten
feeds.description: I'm Sherry Clements, a kindergarten teacher. I have taught kindergarten for 22 years, and I love it! It is amazing to see students enter the classroom not even knowing how to hold a pencil and seeing them learn to read and write by the end of the year. I love teaching in small groups and rotating students with literacy centers and math centers.

feeds.title: Kindergarten Korner
feeds.description: My name is Sarah. i am a mom, wife and kindergarten teacher in Kentucky. I love crafting, shopping, boating and creating resources for my classroom. Thanks for stopping by my blog.

feeds.title: Enchanted Kinder Garden
feeds.description: I'm Keri Brown, a kindergarten teacher. I am currently in my seventh year of teaching. I have taught kindergarten for six years with a year in first thrown somewhere in the middle. I live in south Alabama, but I'm from Birmingham, Alabama. I love crafting which ranges from classroom goodies to wreaths to scrapbooking. I absolutely have no limit to something I will try to make, at least once.

feeds.title: Kindergartenlife
feeds.description: Hello! My name is Sharon Davison and I have the pleasure of being a Kindergarten teacher in Vermont. I have been teaching for 32 years. During my teaching career I have worked with 1st through 4th grade. I am now embarking on a new journey Kindergarten!

feeds.title: Wonders in Kindergarten
feeds.description: Kindergarten is an exciting learning adventure where many wonders, explorations, and investigations take place. I am passionate about inquiry and play based learning, and am greatly inspired by the Reggio approach to learning.

feeds.title: Little Miss Kindergarten - Lessons from the Little Red Schoolhouse!
feeds.description: I am a Kindergarten teacher and I am sliding in to my 16th year. Considering my job consumes a large part of my life and often spills over into my regular life, this blog is dedicated to that.

feeds.title: Teaching With Nancy
feeds.description: My name is Nancy Alvarez. I have taught in both private and public schools. I also have experience with homeschooling, curriculum design, professional development, instructional coaching, bilingual education, and technology integration.

feeds.title: California Kindergarten Association
feeds.description: The mission of the California Kindergarten Association is to foster the development of the whole child by promoting best practices in teaching and learning.

feeds.title: Kindergarten: Holding Hands and Sticking Together
feeds.description: My name is Carolyn Kisloski. A Kindergarten teacher from Upstate New York. I am now in Apalachin Elementary School.

feeds.title: Mrs. Ricca's Kindergarten
feeds.description: After taking a year off to work on my masters at Teachers College Columbia University, I'm thrilled to finally be heading back to kindergarten. Teaching is my life. Free, fun and useful Kindergarten - 1st Grade, Common Core aligned lesson plans, math games, calendars, behavior charts, materials and more.

feeds.title: Kindergarten's 3 Rs | Respect, Resources and Rants
feeds.description: Kindergarten's 3 Rs Blog by Michaele Sommerville. In this blog, you'll get Michaele's reflections, resources, and the occasional rant of all things kindergarten.

feeds.title: Maggie's Kinder Corner
feeds.description: Hello, I'm Maggie. I teach K in S. Missouri! Maggie's Kinder Corner has been around since 1999, but I started a blog with the intent of sharing things I do in my own class to build content lessons, share my design projects, post about items that I use, and share what I have learned about the common core.

feeds.title: Kindergarten Blog
feeds.description: Welcome to Kindergarten Blog! We are Katie Chance, Hannah Manis, Christy Larson, and Deborah Ross. You will see all of us from time to time during your independent learning. Keep up with our regular updates.

feeds.title: Le Roi Daniels Kindergarten
feeds.description: Hello! My name is Alyssa Blue and I am very excited to be a part of the Le Roi Daniels Kindergarten team this year. I look forward to teaching your children and learning from them as they start their schooling careers. I have a passion for working with children and have spent many summers as a camp counselor, helping children (and adults) with exceptionalities explore their interests.

feeds.title: Kinder Korner
feeds.description: Kinder Korner's blog has everything Kinder Parents need to know from apples to ABCs. Subscribe today to get regular updates from this blog.

feeds.title: Learning With Mrs. Parker
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Mrs. Parker. I teach kindergarten and love it. I began this blog as a way to record my journey and reflections as a teacher.

feeds.title: Happy Little Kindergarten
feeds.description: I am a kindergarten teacher in New Jersey. I love creating, engaging and rigorous activities for my kinders and sharing them on this little blog. Thanks for stopping by.

feeds.title: Miss Giraffe's Class
feeds.description: I'm Miss Giraffe living in Arizona. This blog is for me to share teaching ideas and snippets from my world. I hope that you can use some ideas from this blog in your classroom. i am so excited to be able to connect with teachers around the world and share ideas.

feeds.title: Ms. Yankee's Kindergarten Blog
feeds.description: I'm Ms. Yankee (Mackenzie Yankee), a kindergarten teacher. This is my Ms. Yankee's Kindergarten Blog. I am overjoyed to begin my fifth year at Georgetown as your child's Kindergarten Teacher. This is my sixth year in the Hudsonville district. I have had four amazing years teaching Kindergarten at Georgetown.

feeds.title: The Very Busy Kindergarten Classroom
feeds.description: Welcome to The Very Busy Kindergarten Classroom Blog. My name is Sue and I am a first grade teacher. I started to teach first grade and then switched schools to teach kindergarten. I started this blog in 2011 as a place to document the ideas that I was doing in my classroom and share with other teachers. A lot of the ideas I share on my blog come from the books, workshops, and blogs I read.

feeds.title: Clever Classroom Blog - Resources for Kindergarten Teachers
feeds.description: My name is Emma Farrell and I run Clever Classroom. My blog is a place to share my experience and educational perspectives with you. I have over 11 years experience teaching K-2 and also Pre-Kindergarten. I help busy teachers with great ideas and ready to go resources for the Pre-K to 2 classroom.

feeds.title: Wild About Firsties
feeds.description: I'm Jessica, a kindergarten/first grade Texas teacher with over 10 years of classroom experience and a passion for teaching. Stay a while and you will find a lot of classroom activities, a bit of personal life, and a love for learning.

feeds.title: Creating & Teaching
feeds.description: I'm Erin Blecki, a kindergarten teacher. I teach students with autism in grades Pre-K through First. Join Creating and Teaching, a great teaching blog sharing resources and lesson ideas for your classroom.

feeds.title: Kinder Alphabet
feeds.description: Lidia Barbosa is kindergarten teacher at Kinder Alphabet blog. This blog have resources in English and Spanish for kindergarten.

feeds.title: Rubber Boots and elf Shoes
feeds.description: Kindergarten blog about learning though play, investigation, our classroom environment, sensory activities, art, books, and being outside.

feeds.title: Joyful Learning In KC
feeds.description: I love teaching and kids. I am passionate about literacy in the primary classroom. I taught kindergarten and first grades for twenty-two years. I recently left the classroom to become a Literacy Coach in a K-5 building. I feel blessed to be in a school in which I learn something new every day. My hope is to share with teachers ways we can bring the joy of literacy in our classroom practice.

feeds.title: Kindergarten Smiles
feeds.description: I am Caitlin, a kindergarten teacher. I was able to teach primarily in a kindergarten classroom. The small classroom had 93 children who eat a cup of porridge once a day, some don't have a home or parents. I am currently in my ninth year of teaching kindergarten.

feeds.title: Freebielicious
feeds.description: A group of AMAZING educators who come together and share wonderful ideas! Great freebies to try out in your classrooms, and top notch giveaways.

feeds.title: Crayons & Cuties In Kindergarten
feeds.description: I am Jennifer Drake, a kindergarten teacher from Long Island. I am a wife, mom and coffee loving crafter. Teaching is my passion. Inspiring others is my goal. I started as a teaching assistant in a full-day kindergarten in 1999 (the first year kindergarten went 'full day') and secured a teaching position the next fall. I love kindergarten- I know it is the grade I am made to teach.

feeds.title: A Teeny Tiny Teacher
feeds.description: Classroom stories, projects, ideas, activities, and mishaps with a little bit of reality thrown in.

feeds.title: Mrs. Plemons' Kindergarten
feeds.description: I'm Jessica, a kindergarten teacher turned stay at home mommy with a love for teaching, sharing, creating, organizing, and all things pink and sparkly.

feeds.title: Pre-K Pages Blog
feeds.description: I'm Vanessa Levin, an early childhood teacher, consultant, public speaker, and author. I have started the Pre-K Pages as a resource site for Pre-K and preschool teachers. Pre-K Pages offers printable lesson plans and playful learning themes for Preschool, Pre-K, and Kindergarten kids with fun hands-on activities.

feeds.title: Miss Kindergarten - A kindergarten teaching Blog
feeds.description: Hadar is a kindergarten teacher and author of Miss Kindergarten blog.She taught kindergarten, 1st, 2nd and 3rd grade students. She loves blogging, crafting, creating and bargain shopping.

feeds.title: Differentiated Kindergarten Blog
feeds.description: Welcome to Differentiated Kindergarten. I'm Marsha, a teacher-mom committed to the journey of creating a differentiated classroom for my students. It's my goal to meet the needs of all my students through fun, engaging and developmentally appropriate activities.

feeds.title: Kindergarten Lessons Blog
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Patricia Bentham, a kindergarten teacher. My intention is to help you focus your students on investigating topics by nurturing a sense of wonder in your classrooms, which leads to your students asking questions, exploring, experimenting, problem-solving, and recording their new knowledge. I've been inspired by an inquiry-based learning approach for many years and have tried to incorporate it when educating children, writing a blog post, or creating learning plans.

feeds.title: Can Cubs Blog
feeds.description: Can Cubs is a blog structured for play and learning activities for young children. this blog contains informative articles relating to children and articles related to childhood development.

feeds.title: A Place Called Kindergarten
feeds.description: A blog about a Kindergarten classroom. Author Jonelle Bell spends her days with five and six-year-old readers, writers, mathematicians and scientist and love watching them learn and grow.

feeds.title: KindergartenWorks
feeds.description: KindergartenWorks is about maintaining the beauty in teaching kindergarten through planning, classroom organization, rigorous expectations and age appropriate approach... making learning fun and the cool thing to do.
